Settings.ManagerHint: Manage pets, relationships, commands, behaviour tables, and portable data.
Settings.ConfigurationHint: Configure XP awards, the learning curve, dice thresholds, movement, chat visibility, and backups.

Controls.OpenOwnerPerspective: Open Pet Commands as Selected Actor

Context.CommandAsActor: Issue Pet Commands as this Actor

Actions.Vocalize: Bark, hiss, chirp, or otherwise vocalize
Actions.ThreatenTarget: Threaten or growl at a target
Actions.SnapAtTarget: Snap or bite at a target

Command.Title: Issue a command
Command.Help: Choose the owner who gives the command. The relationship determines XP, obedience, and the target DC.
Command.AutomaticActive: The automatic XP-derived value is active.
Command.ManualActive: A manual obedience override is active.
Command.RollBehaviourOnFailure: Roll random behaviour after a failed command
Command.PostToChat: Post rolls and results to chat
Command.ExecuteMovement: Automatically move the pet for successful movement-capable commands and supported random reactions
Command.DifficultyHelp: Negative modifiers lower the DC and make the command easier. Positive modifiers raise the DC and make it harder.
Command.RandomFailureTargets: Possible targets for random behaviour after failure

Relationships.Title: Pet–owner relationships
Relationships.Help: A pet can have one or several owners. Every owner has an independent XP and obedience relationship with the pet.
Relationships.RegisterPet: Register a pet and its owners
Relationships.OwnerHelp: Select one owner by default, or hold Ctrl/Cmd to select several owners.
Relationships.PlayerBehaviourTargetsHelp: Allow the player who owns this Actor to choose the random-behaviour target pools in the lightweight player command panel.

Profile.Title: Pet profile and instinct table
Profile.Help: Attitude, action weighting, target pools, and movement are shared by all relationships for this pet.
Profile.AllowMovement: Allow this pet to move automatically
Profile.MovementHelp: Movement runs when a matching pet token exists on the active scene. Foundry v13 pathfinding and movement constraints are used before execution; blocked routes may result in partial or rejected movement.
Profile.ActionWeightsHelp: The weights are converted deterministically into twenty d20 result slots. Higher weights occupy more slots; zero disables an action.
Profile.DefaultAttackHelp: Used automatically after a successful Attack command. Select a specific D&D 5e attack or keep automatic selection.
Profile.NoAttacksFound: No usable D&D 5e attack activities were found on this Actor.

Data.Title: Portable relationship data
Data.Help: Export everything, one pet, or one relationship as versioned JSON. Imports create an automatic backup before merging or replacing data.

Configuration.Title: Learning, rolls, movement, and retention
Configuration.Help: These world-scoped settings affect every pet relationship. Existing XP is preserved when the curve changes.
Configuration.MovementDistance: Maximum movement distance in grid squares
Configuration.AutoBehaviour: Enable behaviour roll after failure by default
Configuration.PlayerCommandsEnabled: Show the lightweight command panel to players
Configuration.SuccessfulAttackUsesDefault: Use the pet’s default D&D 5e attack after a successful Attack command
Configuration.PlayerAndAttackHelp: Player requests are validated and resolved by one active GM. Attack automation requires the D&D 5e system and a usable attack activity on the pet Actor.

Results.SequenceAttackUnavailable: Rolled {total} against DC {dc}; command succeeded, but the attack was not used: {reason}.

MovementReasons.pet-token-missing: No matching pet token on the active scene
MovementReasons.rejected: Foundry rejected or constrained the movement
MovementReasons.partial: Movement was partially completed before Foundry stopped or constrained it
MovementReasons.already-positioned: The pet is already at the intended position

Empty.NoRelationshipsHelp: Register a pet Actor or selected scene token, then choose one or more owners.

Errors.GmOnly: Only a Game Master can use Pet Command management tools.
Errors.ImportFileRequired: Choose a JSON file to import.
Errors.InvalidJson: The selected file is not valid JSON.
Errors.InvalidXp: XP must be a finite number of zero or greater.
Errors.MigrationFailed: Pet Command could not normalize its stored data. Export or inspect the world setting before continuing.
Errors.RelationshipMissing: The selected relationship no longer exists.
Errors.RelationshipTerminated: The selected relationship is terminated and cannot be rolled.
Errors.SelectOneToken: Select exactly one scene token first.
Errors.CommandTargetRequired: This command requires a scene target.
Errors.NoActiveGm: No active Game Master is available to resolve the command.
Errors.CommandRequestTimeout: The Game Master did not resolve the command request.
Errors.RequesterUnavailable: The requesting player is no longer active.
Errors.RelationshipPermission: You do not control the owner Actor for this relationship.
Errors.TargetUnavailable: The selected target is hidden or unavailable to the requesting player.
Errors.RelationshipDataRequired: A relationship requires an ID, a pet, and an owner.
Errors.ImportObjectRequired: The import must contain a JSON object.
Errors.ImportStateMissing: The import does not contain module state.
Errors.ImportSchemaTooNew: This export uses schema {exportSchema}, but this module supports schema {supportedSchema}.
Errors.GmMutationOnly: Only a Game Master may modify Pet Command data.
Errors.OwnerPerspectiveNotAllowed: Only a Game Master or Assistant Game Master can use Owner Perspective.
Errors.OwnerPerspectiveActorMissing: The selected owner Actor no longer exists.
Errors.OwnerPerspectiveActorRequired: Select exactly one scene token, or open Owner Perspective from an Actor.
Errors.OwnerPerspectiveRelationshipMismatch: The selected relationship does not belong to the chosen owner Actor or is no longer active.

Notifications.TokenSelected: Selected {name} as the pending pet token.

Confirm.DeleteRelationship: Permanently delete this relationship? Export it first when it may be needed later.
Confirm.ReplaceData: Replace every Pet Command pet, relationship, and history entry with the imported JSON? An automatic backup will be created first.
Confirm.RestoreBackup: Restore the latest automatic backup? The current state will itself be backed up first.
Confirm.ResetConfig: Reset every learning, roll, movement, chat, and backup setting to the module defaults?
Confirm.TerminateHelp: Optionally record why the relationship ended, such as pet death, owner death, separation, or adoption.

CommandTargets.come: No scene target is needed. The commanding owner is used automatically.
CommandTargets.stay: This command has no target. It asks the pet to remain where it is.
CommandTargets.heel: No scene target is needed. The commanding owner is used automatically.
CommandTargets.quiet: This command has no target. It only asks the pet to stop vocalising or making noise.
CommandTargets.release: This command has no target. It asks the pet to drop or release whatever it currently holds.
CommandTargets.fetch: Choose the token representing what the pet should fetch or approach.
CommandTargets.guard: Choose someone or somewhere to guard. With no explicit target, the commanding owner is guarded.
CommandTargets.search: This command has no target. The GM interprets what area or clue is being searched.
CommandTargets.track: Choose the creature or token whose trail the pet should track.
CommandTargets.distract: Choose the creature the pet should distract.
CommandTargets.retreat: No scene target is needed. The pet retreats toward the commanding owner.
CommandTargets.attack: Choose the creature to attack. On success, the configured default D&D 5e attack is used.
CommandTargets.move: Choose the token or destination marker the pet should move toward.

Player.Title: Issue a pet command
Player.Help: Only active relationships owned by one of your Actors are shown. The GM client validates and resolves the command.
Player.Disabled: Player pet commands are disabled by the GM.
Player.NoRelationshipsHelp: The GM must create an active relationship whose owner Actor you control.
Player.PerspectiveHelp: Use the same focused command workflow a player uses, scoped to the selected owner Actor. Relationship XP and results remain attached to that owner–pet relationship.
Player.PerspectiveSelectorHelp: Switch between Actors that currently own at least one active pet relationship.
Player.NoPerspectiveRelationshipsHelp: {owner} has no active pet relationships. Create or restore a relationship in the full Pet Command Manager first.
Player.RandomBehaviourTargetsHelp: The GM has allowed this owner Actor to choose which target pools may be used if the pet disobeys. These choices apply to this command attempt only.
Player.RandomBehaviourTargetsOwnerHelp: Choose which target pools may be used if the pet disobeys. Owner Perspective can always adjust these transient choices.

AttackReasons.unsupported-system: The active game system is not D&D 5e
AttackReasons.missing-attack: The pet Actor has no usable attack activity
AttackReasons.attack-not-owned: The resolving GM cannot use the selected attack item
AttackReasons.attack-unusable: The selected attack cannot be used
AttackReasons.attack-error: The D&D 5e attack workflow returned an error
